commerce_invoice_outstanding: UPDATE finance_invoices SET outstanding_minor=outstanding_minor-?,base_outstanding_minor=base_outstanding_minor-?,status=CASE WHEN outstanding_minor=? THEN 'paid' ELSE 'partially_paid' END,version=version+1,updated_at=? WHERE id=?
commerce_invoice_insert: INSERT INTO finance_invoices(id,company_id,party_id,kind,invoice_number,invoice_date,due_date,currency,subtotal_minor,tax_minor,total_minor,outstanding_minor,debit_account_id,credit_account_id,tax_account_id,source_type,source_id,source_version,status,created_by,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,CASE WHEN ?='receivable' THEN erpx_sales_document_number(?,'INV',?) ELSE ? END,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'commerce_fulfillment',?,?,'draft',?,?,?)
commerce_invoice_adjust: UPDATE finance_invoices SET outstanding_minor=outstanding_minor-?,base_outstanding_minor=GREATEST(0,base_outstanding_minor-?),status=CASE WHEN outstanding_minor=? THEN 'paid' ELSE 'partially_paid' END,version=version+1,updated_at=? WHERE id=?
